subject.title: feat(skills): scan session history for workshop ideas

question: Should Skill Workshop send eligible retained session transcripts to the selected model provider through this manual action under the proposed provenance, exclusion, redaction, cost-disclosure, and pending-only rules?
rationale: This creates a new privacy and provider-cost boundary over historical conversations; implementation quality alone cannot determine whether that boundary matches product policy.

options.title: Approve bounded manual scans
options.body: Accept the explicit-click, pending-only workflow with documented exclusions, redaction, provider disclosure, and no transcript copy in scan state.

options.title: Require stricter eligibility
options.body: Add stronger per-scan consent or narrower provenance, age, and workspace constraints before retained content can be sent to a provider.

options.title: Keep current-run review only
options.body: Do not add historical scanning and retain the existing current-run and user-directed learning paths.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded manual scans
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit-click, pending-only workflow with documented exclusions, redaction, provider disclosure, and no transcript copy in scan state.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked request and proposed implementation originate from steipete, making them the strongest available owner for the product and privacy choice.
